enabled.label: Enable OMDb lookups
enabled.description: Turns OMDb rating lookups on or off. Optional; default off.

api_key.label: OMDb API Key
api_key.description: Your OMDb API key. The free tier allows 1,000 requests/day.
api_key.link_text: Get a free OMDb API key

use_ssl_verification.label: Verify TLS certificate
use_ssl_verification.description: Verify the TLS certificate presented by OMDb. Keep this on. Turning it off lets any intercepting hop read and tamper with the traffic — including your API key, which the plugin sends to OMDb in the URL query string and which could be stolen. Use off only when debugging behind a proxy you control.

cache_ttl_seconds.label: Cache TTL (seconds)
cache_ttl_seconds.description: How long to cache OMDb responses; 0 disables the cache. Values above 2,592,000 (30 days) are lowered to 2,592,000, and negative values disable the cache. Optional; default 86400 (24 hours).
